title: haven: KeyMaterialResponse 'Exhausted' sends partialSuccess with no successful client
description: havenmessenger/interop 2c14e62 src/protocol_wire.rs KeyMaterialResponse::Exhausted encodes userStatus=partialSuccess(1) with one client whose clientStatus=keyMaterialExhausted(1) and no success client. protocol-06 §5.2 L1164-1166 and L1283-1284: partialSuccess 'indicates that key material was provided for at least one client of the target user'. mimid rejects it (decision mimid-1wgh.5.63, check_clients: partialSuccess needs >=1 success): DecodingError 'clients list does not match userStatus PartialSuccess'. Fixture crates/mimi-protocol/tests/fixtures/haven/key_material_response_exhausted.bin; test haven_fixtures.rs. Related spec gap: no userStatus fits 'every client exhausted' (see companion wg bead). Report on havenmessenger/interop only with Mark's per-action OK.
